We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Engineer to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge applications that leverage Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves developing services with a focus on reusability , reliability, and performance. You will be a key player in driving the implementation of new AI-driven systems and programs that will impact all business line at Citi globally.
Responsibilities
Architect and Build AI Solutions: Design and architect end-to-end capabilities that integrate with Generative AI technologies.
Develop AI Workflows: Apply a strong understanding of Agentic AI workflows and frameworks to build sophisticated, automated systems.
Drive DevOps Best Practices: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) to streamline the development and deployment of machine learning models.
End-to-End Project Ownership: Manage your deliverables from conception to deployment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure project goals are met.

Collaborate and Innovate: Work closely with global team members, cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and contribute to a culture of innovation.

Experience: 6+ years of relevant experience in Software Development or a Systems Analysis role, with a strong focus on machine learning.
Programming Skills: Strong object-oriented programming skills with expert-level proficiency in Python.
AI/ML Expertise: Deep experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies and Large Language Models.
Application Development: Proven experience building applications that apply LLMs and GenAI to use cases such as search, chat agents, and guided analytics.
DevOps Knowledge: Strong, working knowledge of DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes) and Platform as a Service (PaaS) practices.
Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern software development practices, including microservices architecture and API design principles.
Data Proficiency: Experience with data storage solutions (SQL, Blob Storage)
Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide innovative solutions.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent work experience

Cloud Architecture: Experience with cloud native platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and architectures (e.g., single/multi-tenant).
Large-Scale Systems: Experience designing and implementing microservices-based architectures for large-scale platforms in complex environments.
Leadership: Demonstrated leadership, project management skills for managing self-work, and a proven track record of self-motivation, team work and continuous learning.

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.
As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.
Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.
We are looking for a senior, hands-on Principal AI Engineer who is passionate about solving complex business problems through engineering excellence and modern AI innovation. As a Principal AI Engineer, you will leverage deep technical knowledge — spanning core software engineering and modern Generative/Agentic AI — to drive the creation of high-quality, reusable software and AI frameworks across the organization. You will mentor other engineers, share technical expertise, and promote a culture of technical excellence across multiple engineering teams.
The Principal AI Engineer will report to the Engineering Manager and will act as a floating technical leader across the organization's engineering teams, providing strategic technical direction, building reusable frameworks and a modern AI engineering harness, resolving the organization's most complex technical problems, and unblocking teams to keep delivery moving. There is an expectation to remain hands-on in the codebase and deliver against sprint-level commitments, including dedicated support to high-visibility, executive-tracked AI transformation programs.
From a technical standpoint, the Principal Engineer has full-stack coding and implementation responsibilities and adheres to best practice principles including modern cloud-native software development, agentic AI and RAG system design, agile and scrum, code quality, and tool usage. The Principal I Engineer works to understand, influence, and evolve software and AI architecture, while contributing to the organization's broader technical community.
Responsibilities
Engineering Leadership & Strategic Enablement
Apply deep technical knowledge and expertise across the full software development lifecycle, partnering continuously with stakeholders across engineering teams.
Develop and engineer solutions within multiple agile software delivery teams, collaboratively delivering sprint goals, writing code, and participating in the broader technical community and team-level Agile/Scrum processes.
Design, build, and champion reusable engineering frameworks and a modern AI engineering harness that can be adopted consistently across all engineering teams to accelerate and standardize AI-driven delivery.
Actively contribute to the implementation of critical features and complex technical solutions; write clean, efficient, and maintainable code that meets the highest standards of quality.
Collaborate with other Principal Engineers and architects to define and evolve overall system and AI architecture across the portfolio.
Provide guidance on scalable, robust, and efficient solutions that align with business requirements and industry best practices.
Offer expert engineering guidance to multiple teams, helping them overcome technical challenges, make informed decisions, resolve the most complex technical problems, and unblock delivery.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, and knowledge-sharing across teams.
Continuously track the rapidly evolving AI/technology landscape, evaluate emerging tools and techniques (agentic frameworks, LLM advancements, agentic software engineering, agent engineering etc), and provide recommendations for adoption across the organization.
AI/GenAI & Agentic Engineering
Lead the design and implementation of end-to-end AI/ML and agentic pipelines for document understanding, summarization, themeextraction, and autonomous/semi-autonomous task execution.
Develop and optimize LLM-based solutions for text summarization, content generation, and knowledge extraction fromstructured/unstructured data.
Design, build, and maintain agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable scalable, interoperable multi-agent and tool-using systems.
Build and maintain robust advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, advanced indexing, hybrid search, and re-ranking strategies to ensure accurate, contextually relevant information retrieval.
Implement and optimize vector search and embedding pipelines to enhance document search and information retrieval relevance.
Develop and refine prompt engineering strategies to maximize performance, accuracy, and reliability of language models and agents.
Leverage AI-driven development tools (e.g., Claude Code, DevinAI, Codex, GitHub Copilot and related agentic coding assistants) to enhance development efficiency and accelerate delivery timelines across teams.
Platform, Cloud & Delivery Engineering
Utilize Docker and Kubernetes (and related orchestration tooling such as OpenShift) for application containerization and efficientservice orchestration.
Apply multi-year expertise in Service-Oriented and Microservices architectures, including REST and GraphQL implementations, andevent-driven/cloud-native application design.
Apply hands-on experience with modern frameworks such as Spring Boot, Quarkus, Micronaut, or Vert.x (Java ecosystem), andmodern Python frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic) for AI-centric services.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and engineering harness/tooling (e.g., Harness, Jenkins, Tekton, CircleCI) to streamline build, test, and deployment across teams.
Deploy and monitor AI and software systems in production environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability;contribute to MLOps practices for model versioning, continuous deployment, and monitoring.
Program-Critical Focus: OMAI Initiatives
Provide dedicated, hands-on technical leadership for Operation Management & AI (OMAI) initiatives — currently focused on transforming Real Estate Services operations through AI-enabled process automation to improve operational efficiency and reduce operating expense.
Operate effectively under aggressive, executive-monitored program timelines, proactively identifying technical risk, unblockingdelivery teams, and ensuring committed milestones and benefits are achieved on schedule.
Communicate technical progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to engineering leadership in support of executive-level programreporting.
Problem Solving, Risk & Process
Analyze and effectively troubleshoot complex coding, application performance, architecture, and design challenges across teams.
Conduct thorough root cause analysis for development and performance issues; devise and implement effective, durable resolutions.
Effectively communicate progress, proactively anticipate bottlenecks, manage escalations, and identify, assess, track, and mitigateissues and risks across multiple teams and levels.
Streamline, automate, or eliminate redundant processes across architecture, build, delivery, and production operations whererecurring inefficiencies are identified.

10+ years of experience as a Software Engineer/Developer, with strong core expertise in Python and/or Java.
Multiple years of experience with software engineering best practices (unit testing, test automation, design patterns, peer review,etc.).
Clear understanding of Data Structures and Object-Oriented Principles .
Multiple years of experience with cloud-native development and container orchestration tools (Serverless, Docker, Kubernetes,OpenShift, etc.).
Multiple years of experience with Service-Oriented and Microservices architectures, including REST and GraphQL implementations.
Multiple years of experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot, Quarkus, Micronaut, or Vert.x, and/or modern Python frameworks(FastAPI, Pydantic).
Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks, including Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Model Context Protocol(MCP), for building multi-agent and tool-augmented systems.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery/engineering harness tooling (e.g., Harness, Tekton, CircleCI, Cloudbees Jenkins),either on-premise or public cloud.
Multiple years of experience with agile and iterative software delivery, using tools such as JIRA.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, DevinAI, Codex, GitHub Copilot) to enhance engineering workflows.
Solid understanding and practical experience with code versioning tools, including GitHub Enterprise.
Ability to develop and automate comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality.
Preferred Qualifications
Architecture experience building horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and low-latency applications.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, both on-premise and public cloud (e.g., OpenShift, AWS).
Exposure to event-driven design and architecture (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink).
Exposure to API management tools.
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
Exposure to security, observability, and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, ELK, CloudWatch).
Experience mentoring and providing technical leadership for teams of 5+ developers across multiple engineering groups.
Exposure to database concepts (RDBMS, NoSQL), including SQL/PL-SQL and Oracle, and modern web-based technologies(Angular/React).
Full-stack front-end exposure (React, HTML5, CSS) sufficient to guide and review AI-enabled application UIs.
Experience designing and implementing high-performance RESTful APIs.

This is a senior, hands-on Individual Contributor (IC) role designed to be the primary engine of our "No Ops" transformation. The Lead Infrastructure Automation Engineer will act as a subject matter expert, solution architect, and hands-on developer responsible for designing and implementing the high-impact automation and Agentic AI solutions that will redefine our operational model.
This role is for a versatile technologist who is passionate about eliminating toil, building intelligent systems, and applying AI to solve real-world infrastructure problems at enterprise scale. Your mission will be to tackle our most pressing operational challenges by architecting and developing robust, scalable automation platforms. This is a strategic role focused on continuous evolution and driving a fundamental shift in how we operate.
Core Responsibilities
1. AI-Driven Automation & System Design
Architect, design, and develop the core frameworks for our agentic AI and automation initiatives, utilizing platforms like ARC, ServiceNow, and Ansible.
Act as the lead hands-on developer for creating intelligent, event-driven systems that can autonomously diagnose and remediate infrastructure issues.
Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, and maintainable, applying SRE and software engineering best practices to our operational code.
2. Intelligent Incident & Problem Management
Engineer solutions for automated root cause analysis, leveraging AIOps platforms and machine learning concepts to move from reactive to predictive operations.
Develop systems that can intelligently correlate events from disparate monitoring tools (Netcool, Spectrum, Splunk) to identify systemic issues before they escalate.
Build and refine self-healing capabilities for our network and server infrastructure, reducing MTTR for common failure scenarios.
3. End-to-End Process & Workflow Automation
Analyze and re-engineer core operational processes—including Change Management, Incident Task Management, and hardware provisioning—to be automation-first.
Utilize Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles to codify and automate routine procedures, ensuring consistency and compliance.
Develop integrations between our core platforms (SNOW, Ansible, ARC) to create seamless, end-to-end automated workflows that require minimal human intervention.
4. Service Modernization & Shift-Left Enablement
Act as a technical leader for absorbing new workstreams, such as the recent transfer of L1 Application Support, by identifying and automating the associated operational toil.
Consult with other teams across Foundational Services to design "shift-left" solutions, where ECC's automation platform can take on operational tasks from higher-level support teams.
Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to ensure our operational capabilities evolve with the firm's needs.
Initial Key Initiatives (Examples of Problems to Solve)
To make this tangible, your initial focus will be on leading the design and delivery of our four highest-priority initiatives, which are foundational to our "No Ops" strategy and have a committed ROI:
Distributed & Network Hardware Incident Automation: Build an AI-driven system to auto-diagnose hardware failures (servers, network gear) and trigger automated remediation or replacement workflows.
End-to-End Change Automation: Automate the full lifecycle of standard hardware changes (create, review, implement, validate) using Ansible and ServiceNow.
ITASK & Workflow Orchestration: Use NLP and agentic AI to auto-generate and manage dependent tasks (e.g., LCON dispatches, RMA tracking), removing manual coordination.
L1 Application Support Toil Elimination: Analyze the newly absorbed L1 App Support workload and deploy automation to handle high-volume, low-complexity tasks.
Secondary Responsibilities
Automation Evangelism & Mentorship: Act as a subject matter expert and mentor to junior analysts, evangelizing "automation-first" principles and contributing to upskilling the team.
Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify new process gaps and inefficiencies, proposing and implementing data-driven improvements to enhance operational stability and efficiency.
Qualifications
Required Experience & Expertis e
7+ years in enterprise infrastructure, with a strong background in either Network Operations or Systems Administration (Linux/Windows) in a 24/7 environment.
Proven, hands-on experience designing and building automation solutions that eliminate manual operational work.
Advanced proficiency in automation and IaC tools, particularly Ansible and Terraform. Must be able to write, maintain, and debug complex playbooks and modules.
Strong scripting and development skills in Python. Experience with building operational tools, data processing scripts, or interacting with APIs is required.
Experience applying AI/ML concepts to operational problems. This includes implementing solutions using AIOps platforms (Moogsoft, Datadog AI, etc.) and/or leveraging AI agentic frameworks (like ARC, LangChain, AutoGen) for intelligent automation.
Deep understanding of observability principles and hands-on experience with platforms like Splunk, Elastic, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Expert-level cross-domain troubleshooting skills across network, server, and application layers.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a dedicated SRE or DevOps Engineering role.
